module.Title: Boot the Engine Foundry
module.Teaching: Every C++ executable begins in the main function. The #include line makes a library available, braces group the function body, semicolons finish statements, and return 0 reports that the program ended successfully.
module.PredictionQuestion: Which function is the starting point of a normal C++ program?
module.PredictionExplanation: The operating system begins the program by calling main.
module.DebugPrompt: The library directive needs # at the beginning, and the return statement needs a semicolon.
module.RecallPrompt: Rebuild the minimal Engine Foundry program. Use the exact library iostream, the exact function name main, and return the exact value 0.
module.TransferPrompt: Create another minimal program using the string library. Use the exact function name main and return the exact value 0.
module.PreviewMessage: The Forge Core startup sequence is now online.
